title: Inaaffaa Kan Nyaate
intro: Oduu durii mootummaa ykn macaafa qulqulluu kamiyyuu caalaa durii—balaa dhala namaa isa jalqabaa hinaaffaa irraa dhalate. Lubbuun tokko, angafaa ijoollee lama warra jalqabaa irraa dhalatan, obboleessi quxisuun tokko tola dhorkamee yeroo argatu aariidhaan ilaalaa turte. Wanti itti aanu filannoo dukkanaa’aa ta’ee, dhiiga jalqabaa lafa irratti dhangala’e dhiisee deeme. Eenyummaa, qormaataa fi gaabbii hadhaa’aa sana saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Namoota lamaan jalqabaa lafa irra deeman irraan dhaladhe.
Yeroo tokko Rabbiif aarsaa godheen ture, garuu narraa hin qeebalamne.
Dhiyeessiin obboleessi koo fudhatama kan argate siʼa taʼu, kan koo immoo fudhatama dhabe, kunis wanta ani obsuu hin dandeenyedha.
Obboleessa ofii koo badiisa jedheen doorsise.
Lubbuu obboleessa kootii fudhatee lafa kana irratti ajjeechaa kan raawwate isa jalqabaa ta’e.
Rabbiin uumama dachii—simbirroo gurraattii lafa qottu—akka waanan hojjadhe dhoksu na barsiisuuf erge, gaabbii malee homaa natti hin hafne.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Laga keessatti daa'ima ta'ee kan gatame

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Gaabbiin guutamee warra mo'aman keessaa ta'e
Mootummaa gita hin qabne irratti bulche
outcome.answer: Gaabbiin guutamee warra mo'aman keessaa ta'e

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
